title: ValNorm Quantifies Semantics to Reveal Consistent Valence Biases Across Languages and Over Centuries
reasoning: The paper introduces a method, ValNorm, to quantify "valence"—the intrinsic pleasantness/unpleasantness or goodness/badness associated with concepts. This is a fundamental component of human evaluative judgment, which is foundational to morals and ethics. The work explicitly contrasts widely-shared "non-discriminatory" valence biases with harmful "discriminatory" social biases, providing a tool to analyze attitudes and the ethical dimensions of language embedded in text.
